description: CKEditor plugin for maximizing editor window, including functions for style preservation, iframe shim creation for IE, and command/button setup.

methods.name: protectFormStyles
methods.description: Removes style and className attributes from form elements to protect styles during maximize operation.

methods.name: restoreFormStyles
methods.description: Restores previously saved styles and className attributes to form elements.

methods.name: saveStyles
methods.description: Saves current styles and className of an element, optionally resetting external styles.

methods.name: restoreStyles
methods.description: Restores styles and className to an element from saved data.

methods.name: refreshCursor
methods.description: Refreshes the cursor position in all CKEditor instances, especially for design mode.

methods.name: createIframeShim
methods.description: Creates an iframe shim for IE6 to fix select element penetration issues when maximized.
